versions.changelog:
Job Offer Comparator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Compare multiple job offers comprehensively, including remote vs. on-site, cost of living, commute, and benefits.
- Calculates true total compensation factoring in base, bonus, retirement match, equity (risk-adjusted), health premiums, commute costs, and city cost-of-living.
- Derives effective hourly rate based on real total hours worked, including commute and overtime, plus the dollar value of paid time off.
- Computes negotiation-ready break-even base salary for counter-offers.
- Includes commands for side-by-side comparison, break-even calculation, annotated field guidance, and example data for quick start.
- Transparent about all assumptions and calculation methods; not intended for tax advice or cross-career comparison.
